kjv: The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord
mine: The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord
note: TR plural "basileiai" against singular "basileia" (Sinaiticus, A, C, P); John sees one world-empire handed over.

kjv: which art, and wast, and art to come
note: TR adds "kai ho erchomenos" (from 1:4, 8; 4:8); absent from all early manuscripts. Its absence is deliberate: at the seventh trumpet God has come.
